uniswap-magenta.$description: Uniswap Magenta — Pink supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, nav labels, headings, body copy, and default icon strokes — near-black rather than pure black for a slightly softer read

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text and strong UI borders where extra weight is needed without going to pure black

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text, secondary labels, inactive nav items, and supporting copy

fog.$description: Fog — Disabled states, placeholder text, and faint dividers

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, and button text on magenta fills

bone.$description: Bone — Subtle button borders and faint surface tints

onyx.$description: Onyx — Maximum-contrast text and select icon fills where absolute black is required

electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Decorative icon accent and floating orb color — part of the hero atmosphere palette, not a UI state

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Decorative orb and icon accent in the hero atmosphere

hot-pink.$description: Hot Pink — Decorative orb accent — deeper sibling to the primary magenta for tonal variety in background blobs

sky-cyan.$description: Sky Cyan — Decorative orb and icon accent in the hero atmosphere

mint-teal.$description: Mint Teal — Decorative orb and icon accent in the hero atmosphere

coral-red.$description: Coral Red — Decorative orb accent and select icon tint

forest-green.$description: Forest Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

basel.$description: Sole typeface for every text surface — nav, body, buttons, headings, and display. The signature 485 weight (slightly heavier than regular, lighter than medium) creates a distinctive subtly-compressed feel that no system font replicates. Consistent -0.02em tracking tightens the rhythm at every scale, from 12px captions to 64px display.
